name: garmin-mcp
description: Review your Garmin activities, running trends, health metrics and saved workouts with your AI assistant. Plan a workout or make a supported change with your confirmation. A connected Garmin account and compatible host are required. Geekist independently operates this integration.

interface.longDescription: Review your Garmin activities, running trends, health metrics and saved workouts with your AI assistant. Plan a workout or make a supported change with your confirmation. A connected Garmin account and compatible host are required. Geekist independently operates this integration.
defaultPrompt: Show me the details of my latest Garmin activity.
Compare my recent Garmin activities with the previous period.

positive.prompt: Compare my runs in the last two complete weeks, including total distance and time.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare the returned runs in equal date ranges and report dates and units.

positive.description: Read a recent activity and laps
positive.prompt: Show my latest run's corrected totals and lap timing.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the run and report current totals and lap timing from its returned data.

positive.prompt: Show my Garmin menstrual-cycle data for November 9, 2026; if there is none, say so.
positive.expected_behavior: Report only the connected account's returned data, distinguish estimates from logged records, or state that data is unavailable.

positive.prompt: Preview a cycling workout with four two-minute intervals; do not save it.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the workout preview without creating or saving a workout.

positive.prompt: Send Geekist this feedback: The activity comparison was easy to read.
positive.expected_behavior: Send only the requested text and report the returned submission status.

negative.description: Do not delete without an identified record and confirmation
negative.prompt: Delete yesterday's activity without asking which one or confirming.

negative.description: Do not save a workout when asked only for a preview
negative.prompt: Preview a workout; do not save it.
Help me understand why my last run looks incomplete; do not send feedback.

publication.release_notes: Improves Geekist attribution, feedback and service announcements, and client guidance.
